critical_code_review_comments: Note: Auth page buttons show green (#22c55e) instead of orange. This is due to CSS theming overrides in index.css where .bg-orange-500 is overridden to use --accent-500 variable. If orange is required for these specific pages, the buttons would need to use inline styles or a separate class that isn't overridden.
